paths.py.purpose: single source of truth for all project paths; import this, never hardcode dirs

constants.name: CANONICAL
constants.desc: name of the current output tree dir (e.g. 'output'); bump this one string to promote a new reduction

constants.name: OUT
constants.desc: full path to the canonical reduced-spectra tree

constants.name: CATDIR / CATALOG / CATALOG_RAW
constants.desc: catalog/ dir and the clean/raw catalog CSVs

constants.name: ISM_SUMMARY / EMISSION_SUMMARY / ABSORPTION_SUMMARY / LYA_NHI_SUMMARY
constants.desc: catalog-level product CSV paths

constants.name: REFERENCE / LINELISTS
constants.desc: top-level curated-input directories (scripts read these, never docs/)

constants.name: HOST_EBV
constants.desc: authoritative host-reddening CSV (reference/host_ebv.csv)

constants.name: PHASE_FILE
constants.desc: scripts/project_phase.json -- the machine-readable {function, phase} marker

constants.name: BACKUPS
constants.desc: output_backups/ directory for dated snapshot archives

functions.name: host_ebv_map
functions.desc: read reference/host_ebv.csv and return {SN_UPPER: (host_ebv, err, src)}; more reliable than the catalog mirror

functions.name: project_phase
functions.desc: read scripts/project_phase.json; return (function_str, phase_int) e.g. ('analysis', 5)

backup_output.py.purpose: snapshot the current output/ tree into output_backups/ with a dated phase-tagged name

functions.name: backup_name
functions.desc: build the backup dir name from today's date + project_phase(); format: output_<mon><dd>-<yy>_<function>_phase<N>

functions.name: main
functions.desc: create output_backups/<name>/ via robocopy; exits if the snapshot already exists

coadd.py.purpose: shared spectrum coadd + scaling utilities used by both the STIS and COS product builders

constants.name: COMMON_AXIS
constants.desc: the fixed output wavelength grid (1100-10260 A); finer in UV, coarser to red; shared by all coadds

constants.name: OVERLAP
constants.desc: grating overlap windows used to scale G430L/G750L onto the G230LB anchor

constants.name: GAP_K
constants.desc: FCR gap threshold (px): native-input pairs wider than this get nan-filled instead of bridged

functions.name: clean_wf
functions.desc: apply DQ bitmask (drop 512/256/4, keep 16), remove non-finite/zero flux, sort and deduplicate wavelength

functions.name: resample
functions.desc: simple np.interp onto the common axis; for display; not flux-conserving

functions.name: ivar_combine
functions.desc: inverse-variance weighted mean with optional across-exposure CR sigma-clip (>=3 exposures, absolute error-scaled)

functions.name: align_and_merge
functions.desc: build a union wavelength grid from N grating legs, FCR each onto it, combine; the main per-epoch coadd function

functions.name: scale_factor
functions.desc: flux scale factor to align one grating leg to an anchor in a shared overlap window

functions.name: resample_fcr
functions.desc: flux-conserving resampling via specutils FluxConservingResampler; nan-fills real gaps (wider than GAP_K native px)

functions.name: coadd_native
functions.desc: ivar combine of multiple exposures on their own native-dispersion grid

functions.name: coadd_resel
functions.desc: coadd onto the 2-pixel (resolution element) grid for STIS; COS uses a fixed 0.073 A step

functions.name: coadd_exposures
functions.desc: ivar combine of exposures resampled onto the common axis (used for the cross-grating display merge)

stis_extract.py.purpose: STIS extraction parameter lookup and adaptive trace/bg utilities; imported by reduce_stis_batch.py

constants.name: EXTRSIZE
constants.desc: per-grating default extraction aperture height (px); measured from enclosed-flux curves

constants.name: EXTRSIZE_CLAMP
constants.desc: adaptive-widen bounds (lo, hi) for CCD gratings

constants.name: ECHELLE
constants.desc: tuple of echelle grating names (excluded from standard reduction path)

functions.name: is_echelle
functions.desc: return True if grating is one of the echelle modes

functions.name: extrsize_for
functions.desc: default extraction height for a grating+detector combination

functions.name: trace_window
functions.desc: row range to search for the spectral trace; tightened for MAMA to avoid airglow/host pull

functions.name: adaptive_extrsize
functions.sig: adaptive_extrsize(sci, center, grating, detector, target=0.98, flags=None)
functions.desc: widen the extraction aperture to enclose `target` fraction of cross-dispersion flux, clamped per grating; MAMA and flagged traces stay at default

functions.name: find_trace
functions.sig: find_trace(sci, detector, extrsize, refcol, step, grating)
functions.desc: find the spectral trace center row by collapsing columns and fitting a Gaussian along the cross-dispersion axis

functions.name: adaptive_bg
functions.sig: adaptive_bg(sci, center, extrsize, size, gap, reach)
functions.desc: place background apertures symmetrically around the trace, stepping outward until they clear the extraction box and fit within the detector

functions.name: draw_extraction
functions.sig: draw_extraction(sci, res, detector, extrsize, title, save)
functions.desc: save a 2D PNG showing the raw image with extraction and background apertures overlaid

emission_products.py.purpose: per-source Mg II 2800 + Lya 1216 CSM emission products: line flux, 4-model BIC shape, P-Cygni classification
emission_products.py.run: python emission_products.py [SN ...]  (no args = all SNe in output/)

constants.name: MG2 / LYA
constants.desc: Mg II 2800 doublet centroid (2799.94 A) and Lya rest wavelength (1215.67 A)

functions.name: deredden
functions.desc: Fitzpatrick 1999 (R_V=3.1) dereddening factors for MW (observer frame) + host (rest frame)

functions.name: load_spec
functions.desc: load a _native.txt spectrum; shift wavelength to rest frame, return (w, f, e)

functions.name: bostroem_flux
functions.sig: bostroem_flux(w, f, e, lam0, vline, vcont, vabs, deg, smooth, z)
functions.desc: measure continuum-subtracted line flux following the Bostroem+2026 method; returns (F, F_err, base_F, fc, vc)

functions.name: kwok_shell
functions.sig: kwok_shell(v, A, mu, fwhm, vc, vin)
functions.desc: optically thin expanding shell profile (Kwok 1994): flat-topped with boxy edges, offset centroid, inner hole

functions.name: fit_kwok / fit_models
functions.desc: fit the 4 candidate CSM profiles (Gaussian, Lorentzian, skew-Gaussian, Kwok shell); return BIC scores + parameters

functions.name: _central_notch
functions.desc: conditionally interpolate over the narrow ISM / photospheric-core notch at line center only when broad emission is already present

functions.name: _profile_coherence
functions.desc: coherence score (0-24) for broad vs narrow emission profile; drives P-Cygni / marginal / low_snr grading

functions.name: _is_spike
functions.desc: flag a 1-2 px isolated spike as a false detection; prevents CRs in single-exposure CCD epochs from being reported as Mg II

functions.name: _flux_syst
functions.sig: _flux_syst(w, f, lam0, vline, vcont, deg, base_F, z)
functions.desc: systematic flux error from continuum placement variation

functions.name: compute_emission
functions.desc: run the full emission measurement for one SN across all epochs; returns {line: [records]}

functions.name: build_emission
functions.desc: write per-SN JSON sidecar + per-epoch diagnostic PNGs

functions.name: main
functions.desc: entry point; processes each SN in `names` (or all SNe in output/) and appends to the catalog summary CSV

ism.py.purpose: ISM absorption curve-of-growth: NUV EW measurements -> Fe II anchor -> per-ion column densities + FUV apparent optical depth

constants.name: TAU_K
constants.desc: tau0 = TAU_K * N * f * lam / b  (CGS; from the Voigt-profile analytic core)

constants.name: LIN_K
constants.desc: W/lam = LIN_K * N * f * lam  (linear CoG regime only)

constants.name: AOD_K
constants.desc: N = AOD_K / (f*lam) * integral(tau dv)  (Savage & Sembach 1991; the 1/300 bug from a unit error was fixed in the 300x-retraction)

constants.name: ANCHOR_TAU
constants.desc: max tau0 for a 'good anchor': at least one detected Fe II line must be below this to keep N from floating freely on the flat CoG

constants.name: NUV_GRATINGS / FUV_GRATINGS
constants.desc: where the Fe II / Mg II / ISM forest lives vs where COS resolved lines sit (G140L excluded: R~2000 doesn't resolve narrow ISM)

functions.name: fit_group
functions.sig: fit_group(w, f, group, all_lams, pad, cont_shift)
functions.desc: fit a blended group of nearby ISM lines jointly: one Gaussian sigma, one amplitude per line, on a local linear continuum

functions.name: deblend_ews
functions.sig: deblend_ews(w, f, e, inr, n_mc, seed, link, return_fits)
functions.desc: measure deblended EW + error (MC photon noise) for every detected ISM line in the spectrum

functions.name: cog_F
functions.desc: the Voigt CoG integral F(tau0) = integral exp(-tau0 exp(-u^2)) du, evaluated numerically

functions.name: collect
functions.desc: gather CoG input points for one ion: (lam, f_osc, W, W_err); drop lines below snr_min

functions.name: fit_b_N
functions.sig: fit_b_N(lam, fo, y, ye, b0, logN0)
functions.desc: fit both b and logN from a set of Fe II lines in log-EW space; the Fe II anchor

functions.name: fit_N
functions.sig: fit_N(lam, fo, y, ye, b, logN0)
functions.desc: fit logN with b fixed at the Fe II value; used for all other ions

functions.name: aod_column
functions.sig: aod_column(w, f, e, lam0, fval, vwin, cpad, sig_det)
functions.desc: apparent optical depth column for one RESOLVED FUV line (Savage & Sembach 1991); returns dict with N, status, saturation flag

functions.name: analyze
functions.sig: analyze(w, f, e, ism, n_mc, clean_spikes)
functions.desc: full per-epoch ISM analysis: EW deblending -> CoG anchoring -> per-ion N; returns structured result dict

functions.name: run_catalog
functions.desc: run ISM analysis over all SNe in the output tree; write per-epoch *_cog.csv files + the global ism_cog_summary.csv

functions.name: run_fuv
functions.desc: run apparent optical depth analysis on all COS FUV medium-res (G130M/G160M) spectra; write fuv_aod_summary.csv

lya_nhi.py.purpose: automated N(HI) from damped Lya absorption for early photospheric-backlight epochs (phase < 50d, G140L)
lya_nhi.py.run: python lya_nhi.py [SN ...]  (no args = all SNe with G140L in output/)

constants.name: FLUX_GATE
constants.desc: minimum median flux in 1225-1290 A rest to accept an epoch as a usable backlight

constants.name: PHASE_MAX_CLEAN
constants.desc: maximum phase (days) for a photospheric-backlight epoch

constants.name: RMS_GATE
constants.desc: max RMS of O(1)-normalized residuals from the Voigt fit

constants.name: VABS_SYST_RANGE
constants.desc: +/- km/s range for the v_abs systematic: captures host-ISM velocity spread

functions.name: lya_tau
functions.desc: Lya Voigt-profile optical depth (Hjerting function via scipy.special.wofz); b fixed at 25 km/s in the damped regime where wings are b-independent

functions.name: backlight_flux
functions.desc: median flux in 1225-1290 A rest (the safe red wing of Lya); the backlight quality gate

functions.name: fit_nhi
functions.sig: fit_nhi(w, f, logN0, b, vabs, wlo, whi)
functions.desc: fit logN(HI) to a photospheric-backlight Lya trough; continuum = quadratic; returns (logN, rms_resid) or (None, None)

functions.name: run_sn
functions.desc: find all early G140L epochs for one SN, gate on flux + phase + fit quality, return list of result dicts

functions.name: main
functions.desc: entry point; calls run_sn for each SN and writes catalog/lya_nhi_summary.csv

absorption_products.py.purpose: per-source ISM/absorption JSON sidecar: combines automated CoG + automated N(HI) + curated deep columns into one product

constants.name: _SOLAR_REF
constants.desc: log(X/H)_solar + 12 values (Asplund 2009) for the ISM abundance ions

constants.name: _ION_ERR_GATE
constants.desc: skip [X/H] for ions whose logN_err >= this (0.5 dex); prevents poorly-measured columns from being reported as metallicities

functions.name: load_nhi_summary
functions.desc: return {SN_UPPER: nhi_row} from catalog/lya_nhi_summary.csv

functions.name: load_cog_summary
functions.desc: return {sn_dir: adopted_row} for every SN with an adopted CoG epoch in ism_cog_summary.csv

functions.name: load_cog_ions
functions.desc: read the per-epoch *_cog.csv for the adopted epoch; return {ion: {logN, logN_err, n_lines, limit}}

functions.name: run_sn
functions.desc: assemble the 3-tier absorption product for one SN and write its *_absorption.json sidecar

functions.name: main
functions.desc: entry point; writes the per-SN sidecars + catalog/absorption_summary.csv

catalog_clean.py.purpose: clean the raw MAST query catalog: dedup, SIMBAD+NED cross-match, host E(B-V), TNS z; run on Windows
catalog_clean.py.run: python catalog_clean.py [--host-sync]  (--host-sync = network-free re-join of host_ebv only)

functions.name: name_variants
functions.desc: generate SIMBAD-resolvable name variants from the proposer-typed name (e.g. M82-SN -> SN 2014J)

functions.name: simbad_by_name
functions.desc: query SIMBAD for object type + redshift; tries each name variant

functions.name: ned_z_by_name
functions.desc: NED redshift lookup as a fallback when SIMBAD has no z

functions.name: coord_fallback
functions.desc: SIMBAD coordinate cone search (8 arcsec); last resort when the name fails entirely

functions.name: xmatch_one
functions.desc: cross-match one SN: try name, then coordinate; cache the result

functions.name: ebv_one

functions.name: tns_one
functions.desc: TNS API lookup: discovery date, type, z; falls back to cone search

functions.name: join_host_ebv
functions.desc: join the curated host_ebv.csv onto the final catalog DataFrame

functions.name: host_sync
functions.desc: network-free re-sync of the host_ebv column in the clean catalog from reference/host_ebv.csv

functions.name: main
functions.desc: orchestrate the full catalog clean: raw CSV -> xmatch -> E(B-V) -> TNS -> host_ebv join -> write catalog/uv_sn_catalog_clean.csv

build_products.py.purpose: assemble SN-level products: time-series waterfall, per-epoch cross-grating coadds, manifests, scaling CSVs

functions.name: gather_epochs

functions.name: counts_2d
